note: Original project-authored remediation guidance. Review before use; BaselineGuard never executes these commands.

manual.linux.01.summary: Set `PermitRootLogin no` in a drop-in file under /etc/ssh/sshd_config.d/ and reload the daemon.
manual.linux.01.impact: Administrators must use named accounts with sudo; verify one works first.
manual.linux.01.authority: Local file, or your configuration-management system if it owns /etc/ssh.

manual.linux.02.summary: Set `PasswordAuthentication no` in a drop-in file under /etc/ssh/sshd_config.d/ and reload the daemon.
manual.linux.02.impact: Confirm key-based access works for every administrator before disabling passwords.
manual.linux.02.authority: Local file, or your configuration-management system if it owns /etc/ssh.

manual.linux.03.summary: Set `X11Forwarding no` in a drop-in file under /etc/ssh/sshd_config.d/ and reload the daemon.
manual.linux.03.impact: Remote GUI forwarding stops working over SSH.
manual.linux.03.authority: Local file, or your configuration-management system if it owns /etc/ssh.

manual.linux.04.summary: Set `MaxAuthTries 4` in a drop-in file under /etc/ssh/sshd_config.d/ and reload the daemon.
manual.linux.04.impact: Users with many keys loaded may be disconnected sooner.
manual.linux.04.authority: Local file, or your configuration-management system if it owns /etc/ssh.

manual.linux.05.summary: Set `ClientAliveInterval 300` in a drop-in file under /etc/ssh/sshd_config.d/ and reload the daemon.
manual.linux.05.impact: Idle sessions are probed every five minutes.
manual.linux.05.authority: Local file, or your configuration-management system if it owns /etc/ssh.

manual.linux.06.summary: Set `ClientAliveCountMax 3` in a drop-in file under /etc/ssh/sshd_config.d/ and reload the daemon.
manual.linux.06.impact: Unresponsive sessions are dropped after the configured count.
manual.linux.06.authority: Local file, or your configuration-management system if it owns /etc/ssh.

manual.linux.07.summary: Persist `net.ipv4.ip_forward = 0` in a sysctl drop-in and apply it.
manual.linux.07.impact: Disables routing; do not apply on routers, VPN gateways, or container hosts without review.
manual.linux.07.authority: Local file, or configuration management if it owns /etc/sysctl.d.

manual.linux.08.summary: Persist `net.ipv4.conf.all.accept_redirects = 0` in a sysctl drop-in and apply it.
manual.linux.08.authority: Local file, or configuration management if it owns /etc/sysctl.d.

manual.linux.09.summary: Persist `net.ipv4.conf.default.accept_redirects = 0` in a sysctl drop-in and apply it.
manual.linux.09.impact: ICMP redirects are ignored on new interfaces.
manual.linux.09.authority: Local file, or configuration management if it owns /etc/sysctl.d.

manual.linux.10.summary: Persist `net.ipv4.conf.all.send_redirects = 0` in a sysctl drop-in and apply it.
manual.linux.10.impact: Host no longer sends ICMP redirects.
manual.linux.10.authority: Local file, or configuration management if it owns /etc/sysctl.d.

manual.linux.11.summary: Persist `net.ipv4.conf.all.accept_source_route = 0` in a sysctl drop-in and apply it.
manual.linux.11.authority: Local file, or configuration management if it owns /etc/sysctl.d.

manual.linux.12.summary: Persist `net.ipv4.tcp_syncookies = 1` in a sysctl drop-in and apply it.
manual.linux.12.impact: Mitigates SYN floods with negligible overhead.
manual.linux.12.authority: Local file, or configuration management if it owns /etc/sysctl.d.

manual.linux.13.summary: Persist `kernel.randomize_va_space = 2` in a sysctl drop-in and apply it.
manual.linux.13.authority: Local file, or configuration management if it owns /etc/sysctl.d.

manual.linux.14.summary: Persist `fs.suid_dumpable = 0` in a sysctl drop-in and apply it.
manual.linux.14.impact: Set-uid programs no longer produce core dumps.
manual.linux.14.authority: Local file, or configuration management if it owns /etc/sysctl.d.

manual.linux.19.summary: Set a restrictive default umask (027 or stricter) for login sessions.
manual.linux.19.impact: Newly created files are no longer world-readable; check shared-directory workflows.

manual.linux.20.summary: Enable and verify system time synchronisation.
manual.linux.20.impact: Clock may step on first sync; coordinate with time-sensitive services.
manual.linux.20.authority: Local service, or your time-sync policy.
